call_points.text: No numeric FY27 guidance in the extracted pages; strategy framed as sustained double-digit profitable growth.
Prestige & Above NSV grew 8.6%, or 11.3% excluding AP and Maharashtra.
Price/mix added 6.1% to NSV growth in FY26.
Value-chain productivity of about ₹420 Cr offset roughly 93% of inflation.
Advertising and promotion spend was ₹1,295 Cr, a rate of investment of 10.4%.
Free cash flow was ₹1,374 Cr and return on capital employed 28.4%.
Nao Spirits go-to-market is now fully integrated with the USL playbook.

penalties.details: By order dated 22nd April 2025, the Commission held that the Company is liable for deficiency of service, and directed the Company, along with its co-defendant to jointly pay the complainant: 1) INR 50,000/- towards compensation 2) INR 10,000/- towards costs 3) INR 1,830 + interest at 9% pa from 3rd August 2013 Order was made available to the Company on 8 October 2025.
